base: The same 36 verified stories as the v2/v3 set: v1's verified list, with the two Reuters Tier 2 swaps from v2 kept (slot 19 Gaza overnight, slot 35 Congo Ebola). No story added, removed or re-dated for v4; only the artwork and layout were rebuilt from zero.
edition: v4 — from-scratch rebuild under skill v3.0.0 core (winner template §2, one-rule §1)
notes: Where a story came from v1, source_url is null: v1 recorded outlet plus date rather than links, and no link was invented after the fact. The two v2 stories carry their full Reuters links. Clock times appear in the image for two events only — 00:54 UTC (AP Cairo update) and 05:29 UTC (Reuters Ebola); everything else is dated Thursday 26 Nov 2026 with no clock time stated. v4 redraws all 13 scenes and the map from scratch, and the ALSO briefs 14–36 are headline-only, with sources collected in one line under the list. entry.png is 1024x1024, 728044 bytes, sha256 47c16b6964b183db4c289a70ccc3d5111eb80d62fd61cc5fd36e7f6b19654b29.
